mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an argument in which the premises do not only support but also guarantee the conclusion."
A deductive argument is an argument in which the premises do not only support but also guarantee the conclusion.

Arguments are the chief concern of logic.

The buyer is a man, but it cannot be Mr.

Formal fallacies are the types of mistakes we make in our attempt to construct syllogisms (deductive reasoning/a logical argument with two premises and a conclusion) or in using logical symbols.

public offices are responsible for our economic problem.
